title: Design System: ABI liquid wallet and o11 console

extensions.scope: Approved clear liquid-glass wallet replaces charcoal card in Overview/Wallet; shared o11 Inter console and opaque gray content retained. Mobile reference supplies stacking only. Wallet replaces Treasury presentation; existing backend and analytics remain.

typography.fontSource: Official self-hosted inter-variable.woff2, weights 100–900, SIL OFL in fonts/OFL-Inter.txt; next/font/local. IBM Plex Mono remains self-hosted at 400/500 for code/credentials.

materials.content: Opaque neutral content, forms, provider rows and dialogs.
materials.glass: Navigation, menus and clear liquid-glass ABI wallet card only; working content/dialogs remain opaque.

wallet.composition: Authored alpha optical rim with semantic text and actual ABI ABMark; decorative layers hidden from accessibility APIs.

layout.mobile: At 760px: stacked overview, 62px header, hidden desktop links, 20px content side padding, dock max-width 420px and safe-area bottom placement. Floating dock also appears on desktop.
layout.walletMobile: At 760px, stacked with 30px gap; balance metrics form one opaque gray strip, allocation/activity rows wrap.

shadows.name: wallet-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive pointer hover with no reduced-motion preference.

navigation.removed: More menu and standalone ledger/webhook navigation; legacy backend remains.
navigation.theme: Interface pinned light; nonfunctional Theme menu removed.
navigation.wallet: Overview full card and Wallet details open the retained internal treasury route, now presented as Wallet.
navigation.sellerEntry: Sell on ABI removed from buyer header; seller entry retained in account menu.

behavior.marketplace: Published inventory only, provider/product segmentation, search and category tabs; no Demo/Live selector. Order content appears in the separate Purchases tab.
behavior.connect: Dialog-based scoped key creation, one-time secret, replacement and revocation; no secret localStorage. New keys omit x402BudgetUsdc; read defaults, explicit pay, inherited agent allowance/spending/approval controls. Existing key-specific caps remain displayed and enforced.
behavior.billing: Overview and Spending limits; UTC calendar day/week/month windows, shared workspace cap, total caps expiring within 90 days, recurring opt-out. Existing budgets and approval controls apply. Connected-service writes unavailable. Editing a total window preserves its original start time.
behavior.sellerSession: Only a definitive 401 ends the session. Transient network/429/5xx and malformed responses retain the session and offer retry. Separate buyer/seller identities, verification and MFA remain.
behavior.wallet: Verified Receive; department/shared allocation; review-before-POST Move; actual pending/recent activity. Totals exclude agent aliases; unknown balances explicit. Failed/malformed receiving-profile refresh clears old details. Row-selected department/shared destination is preserved. Existing Cash/analytics code remains without a standalone Wallet analytics tab.
behavior.recovery: Settings → Security and recovery with per-operation confirmations; existing custody, approval and server controls preserved.

extensions.financialLimits: USD card funding remains disabled pending operator configuration and usage/refund policy; separate from Base Sepolia USDC. No USD consumption or fiat-to-USDC conversion. Study/fixtures do not establish live funding, purchase, fulfillment or settlement.
extensions.evidenceLimits: Fresh finish verdict: ship after both findings resolved. Refreshed bounded confirmation: 14 screenshots and report.json; synthetic checks cover malformed successful response and 503 clearing the receiving profile, plus second-department/shared allocation destinations. Final build passes; lint zero errors/eight baseline warnings. No production release or live financial-operation certification. Launcher/detector/phase/spec automation unavailable; study values illustrative.

motion.name: wallet-highlight
motion.purpose: Subtle mouse highlight, opacity 0.18 to 0.38 and interactive hover lift translateY(-2px); pointer tracking/transitions disabled with reduced motion.

reviewEvidence.captures: 14 local ignored captures: overview/wallet/receive/allocate/move-review/payment-key/recovery-review at 1440px and 390px; not committed.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Restrained blue action, visibly disabled when prerequisites are unavailable.

components.name: Text field
components.description: Opaque neutral field with visible focus; dialog fields become 16px on mobile.

components.name: Category controls
components.description: Underlined neutral categories with equal prominence and aria-pressed state.

components.name: Checklist row
components.description: Opaque setup row beside the ABI vault on desktop; overview stacks on mobile.

components.name: Desktop destinations
components.description: Five buyer destinations; seller substitutes Inventory and Payouts. No More menu. Floating dock shares these destinations.

components.name: Provider row
components.description: Structural preview only; published provider data supplies real titles and availability.

narrative.northStar: ABI liquid wallet and o11 console
narrative.overview: Actual ABI identity and approved clear liquid-glass wallet with self-hosted Inter, opaque neutral working content and selective glass navigation/menus. Overview full card opens Wallet; desktop summary places card left and balances/actions right, mobile stacks. Public-home structure retained.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque light-gray working surfaces; glass reserved for navigation, menus and clear ABI wallet.
Five role-specific destinations with no More or standalone ledger/webhook navigation.
Equal commerce categories, published inventory and honest financial availability.

rules.name: Selective glass
rules.body: Keep working content opaque and reserve glass for navigation, menus and the ABI card.

dos: Preserve the actual ABI mark and semantic LiquidWalletCard content.
Keep category labels legible and equally prominent.
Distinguish USD credits, Base Sepolia USDC and live operational evidence.
Preserve sessions on transient seller service errors and offer retry.
donts: Do not introduce study balances or invented provider data.
Do not expose or persist credential secrets as decorative content.
Do not infer live funding, purchases, fulfillment or deployment from UI studies or fixtures.
Do not imply card-network capability or duplicate agent aliases in wallet balances.
Do not offer an old receiving address as verified after malformed profile refresh.
